name: Software Rollout
description: Roll out software to many clients: create packages from installation files (MSI/EXE/DEB/RPM/anything) plus an installation command per platform and distribute them to multiple clients with one click. Online clients install immediately (live result), offline clients receive the job in the offline queue and install automatically the next time they come online. With a panel action on the client and {file}/{dir} placeholders in the command; without a command, MSI/EXE/DEB/RPM are installed silently and automatically.
author: BYTERA
